title: Provider Copy Says All Three, Not Just Anthropic
userRequest: Otterpace's BYO-key coaching became multi-provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), but the copy never followed. Every user-facing and developer-facing surface outside Settings and onboarding still named Anthropic as if it were the only option. The material one was the privacy policy: site/privacy.html told users their question, activity summary, personalization profile and journal slice were "sent to our backend and on to Anthropic" — simply false for anyone who connected an OpenAI or Gemini key. A privacy policy that names the wrong data recipient is an accuracy problem, not a polish problem.
description:
Corrected every surface that names a provider, and made the in-app copy derive from the connected provider so it cannot drift again.

The correctness fix: site/privacy.html now says the user connects a key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google (Gemini), and that the request goes to the provider whose key they connected, and to no other provider. Every prior disclosure was preserved verbatim (Keychain-only key, questions not retained, profile and journal never to analytics, roughly two weeks of journal entries with long notes shortened, Settings to Privacy erases them) and each is now pinned by a test, so a future edit for brevity cannot silently drop a commitment.

The durable fix: CoachProvider.keyRequirementCopy(action:provider:) derives the sentence from the active provider, read from the same keyStore.activeProvider the request path uses, so the copy and the request can never name different providers. CoachProvider.allNamesSentence builds the provider list from displayOrder, so a fourth provider updates user-facing prose the moment it is added to the enum. This is the pattern CoachPreviewDestinationCard already used, which is why that card never went stale when the other two providers landed.

Also corrected: README, docs/go-live-runbook.md, the App Store listing's Data Not Collected justification ("straight to the user's chosen AI provider"), backend header comments in api/race-import.ts and api/race-search.ts that described the request as carrying an Anthropic key, and a full rewrite of docs/ai-coach.md for the multi-provider architecture with an "adding a fourth provider" section naming the only two places that enumerate providers.

One claim the plan asked to verify rather than assume: the runbook said @anthropic-ai/sdk was "the only runtime dependency". package.json has two (jose as well). Corrected, and reframed to the accurate point — Anthropic is the only vendor SDK shipped, since the OpenAI and Gemini branches use fetch, so adding those providers added no dependencies.

Guards: a new test/site/privacy-copy.test.ts reads the policy and asserts that if it names any supported provider it names all three, that it says the destination is the provider the user connected, that it never claims a single fixed destination, and that every pre-existing disclosure survives. Tests/AppCoreTests/CoachProviderCopyTests.swift asserts the derived copy names the connected provider and no other, names every provider when none is connected, reads grammatically, and carries no em dashes.

Known gap: the connected-provider branch of the derived copy has unit coverage for all three providers but no visual scenario; only the no-key branch is captured.
